name: chronoflow
description: Todo app and time tracker with Jira integration

scripts.dev: concurrently -k --handle-input -n main,renderer "npm run dev:main" "npm run dev:renderer"
scripts.build: npm run build:main && npm run build:renderer

releaseInfo.releaseNotes:
### ChronoFlow v0.1.14

#### New Features:
- **Split time entries:** a scissors icon on every entry opens a split dialog with two modes — cut the entry at a point (optionally moving the second part to another issue), or remove/move a whole block (e.g. cut out your lunch break, or move a meeting from 13:00–14:00 to another issue). Works on stopped and running entries; the timer keeps running from the end of the removed block.

#### Critical Fixes:
- **Fixed recurring data loss (the big one):** `INSERT OR REPLACE` on issues triggered SQLite's `ON DELETE CASCADE`, silently wiping every time entry of every existing issue on each issue sync (e.g. loading Jira data, creating an issue). Replaced with a proper upsert (`ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE`) — syncing now never destroys entries.
- **Loading a different day no longer deletes other days:** same root cause as above; entries on all dates now survive Jira loads.
- **Jira worklogs between 00:00–02:00 local time now load correctly:** the worklog query used UTC day boundaries; switched to local-day boundaries and raised per-issue pagination to 1000 results so nothing is silently missed.
